items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Irv did most of the work, Irwin not Irving, but everybody always called him Irv, he was just a miracle worker, doing that show was a whole other thing... I was doing the Show of Shows, with Irv

ctx.x: We had Irv Kluger playing drums, we had, yeah it was a good band.
There was a drummer named Jackie Mills, later on.
